aesthetic: The Clearing Desk — a programmatic trading terminal where the spread is made visible
anchor: The corpus asks one question — who keeps the spread between the IO/CPM an intermediary charges and the price that actually clears in-platform — so its world is the trading screen on which that spread lives: a bidstream ledger glowing in a dark room, columns of CPMs and take-rate percentages, a deal ID resolving in milliseconds, the green of the price that clears set against the amber of the fee that leaks on the way to the publisher.
rationale: The structural metaphor is the auction and the supply path (IO → DSP → exchange → SSP → publisher), every hop skimming a fee, so the figures should read like a market dashboard and an exchange ticker rather than a humanities study: tabular monospace numerals, a grotesque terminal display face, tight sharp radii. The brand accent is CLEARING-GREEN — the green of a money screen and of the spread an intermediary captures — deliberately distinct from every neighbor on the Media & Advertising shelf (Roku violet, the cooler institutional blues, the warm India/LATAM tones). The figure palette pairs it with an IO-side ink-navy (the buyer's gross price), an ad-tax amber (the fee that leaks at each hop), a deal-ID cyan (the curated identity layer), and an auction rose (the open-market bid). Cool light paper with near-black slate for day reading; a true dark, lit-terminal register for night. A grotesque sans display, a readable transitional serif for the long-form argument, and a true monospace because this corpus is, above all, about numbers.

fonts.display: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial Nova', 'Segoe UI', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.body: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
